purpose: Record first-release WeChat API candidates, explicit minimum-base-library evidence, and unresolved applicability without converting the device cohort into a support promise.

projectConstraints.businessCore: packages/shared owns business rules and API orchestration; platform APIs are injected through adapters

officialApiEvidence.apiDefinitionSync: CHANGELOG says API definitions were updated to base library 3.17.0 in v5.2.2 on 2026-07-27.
officialApiEvidence.maintenanceEvidence: 285 commits were shown by the repository at review time; latest inspected commit was 2026-09-01.
officialApiEvidence.officialDocsDirectFetch: The linked developers.weixin.qq.com pages could not be retrieved in this review. Where a minimum version is stated below, it is taken from the pinned WeChat-maintained API typings; caveats are recorded per API.

officialCloudBaseTutorialEvidence.claim: The tutorial lists mini-program base library >= 2.2.3 as the minimum for wx.cloud and shows wx.cloud.init plus wx.cloud.callFunction.
officialCloudBaseTutorialEvidence.scope: Conditional on using the direct wx.cloud namespace in a WeChat Cloud Development mini program.
officialCloudBaseTutorialEvidence.retrievalNote: The search result returned the relevant official page text; a direct page open timed out during this review.

sourceAudit.reuseDecision: Use existing PRD and the WeChat-maintained API typings as evidence; add no runtime dependency and adopt no third-party implementation. Typings provide version annotations but do not prove account entitlements, runtime behavior, or the complete app support floor.

apiRequirements.requirement: First-release sign-in/session flow; the planning record references wx.login.
apiRequirements.versionEvidence: Pinned API typings have no general mini-program minimum on wx.login; the nearby 2.3.1 note is explicitly plugin-only and cannot be used as the app floor.

apiRequirements.requirement: ID08 requires user-consented, verified WeChat phone-number capability; manual phone entry is not an approved substitute. E02 still gates account eligibility and actual enablement.
apiRequirements.candidate: button open-type=getPhoneNumber with the dynamic-code exchange flow
apiRequirements.versionEvidence: The pinned typings mark the button callback at 1.2.0. The new dynamic-code behavior is documented as starting at 2.21.2 in issue #236 of the WeChat-maintained typings repository; that issue is secondary to the canonical API page, which could not be fetched during this review. Treat 2.21.2 as a corroborated conditional floor, not a complete product floor.

apiRequirements.requirement: First-release posts and listings support approved image attachments, with format, count, size, privacy, and moderation constraints defined in the PRD.
apiRequirements.versionEvidence: The pinned WeChat-maintained API typings mark wx.chooseMedia as requiring base library 2.10.0; a separate 2.11.1 annotation applies only inside mini-program plugins.

apiRequirements.requirement: Client/server operations require a CloudBase request path; actual business permission enforcement stays server-side.
apiRequirements.candidate: wx.cloud.callFunction or a Taro/platform adapter over the approved CloudBase client API

candidateMinimums.basis: Official CloudBase WeChat mini-program tutorial lists 2.2.3 as the minimum for wx.cloud.
No version floor established for an alternative adapter by the reviewed sources.

apiRequirements.versionEvidence: The official CloudBase tutorial gives the direct wx.cloud namespace a 2.2.3 minimum. This is conditional on choosing that path; the product call adapter and framework path are not implemented yet, so the row-level minimum remains unset.

apiRequirements.requirement: Image evidence must be uploaded and then governed by the confirmed per-request server authorization and independent-public-copy design.
apiRequirements.candidate: wx.cloud.uploadFile, wx.uploadFile, or a server-mediated upload adapter; exact route is not selected.

candidateMinimums.basis: Conditional on the direct wx.cloud namespace; the official CloudBase tutorial lists 2.2.3 as the minimum for wx.cloud.
The pinned typings provide no general mini-program minimum; their 1.9.6 note is plugin-only.
Exact route and corresponding official version evidence have not been selected.

apiRequirements.versionEvidence: The direct wx.cloud.uploadFile candidate inherits the conditional wx.cloud minimum of 2.2.3. The wx.uploadFile candidate has no general minimum in the pinned typings; its 1.9.6 note is plugin-only. The upload route is not selected, so the row-level minimum remains unset.

apiRequirements.requirement: Payment is held behind E04; the applicable merchant capability, costs, and production transaction flow are not verified.
apiRequirements.versionEvidence: The pinned type source gives no general minimum annotation for wx.requestPayment. Do not use it to set the current API floor while payment applicability is gated.

apiRequirements.requirement: SP01 diagnostic probe only; not a first-release business capability.
apiRequirements.versionEvidence: The pinned API typings mark wx.getPerformance as requiring base library 2.11.0. Its presence does not supply FPS or establish the product support floor.

floorAnalysis.conditionalBasis: First-release phone-number verification is a confirmed requirement and the planned dynamic-code flow is tied to base library 2.21.2.
reasonNotFrozen: The direct wx.cloud call and upload candidates have a documented 2.2.3 namespace minimum, but the product upload route is not selected and alternative upload/adapter paths have no verified floor in the reviewed sources.
wx.login has no general minimum annotation in the reviewed type source.
The secure phone-code minimum is supported by the maintained repository's issue record, while the canonical WeChat page was not retrievable in this review.
No completed formal product package exists for verifying the Taro 4.3.1 runtime path and capability behavior on the proposed floor.
The exact device support groups and QP05 sampling path remain open in R03.

observedDeviceBaseLibraryReports.interpretation: This is the current supplied test-device cohort report, not a minimum support promise. The iPhone report predates the user's later iOS update; the earlier SEA-AL10 report said 3.17.4 and is retained as historical evidence.

floorAnalysis.decision: Do not freeze a global minimum or device support group from this matrix alone. Keep R03 pending.

excludedFromFloor.reason: The confirmed address flow does not require forced GPS or wx.chooseLocation.
E04 is pending and payment is not part of the current verified runtime flow.
SP01 diagnostic-only; no FPS evidence and not a product feature.

checks: JSON parses and required API rows exist.
A global minimum remains null while any required API route has no version evidence or implementation path.
Plugin-only API annotations are not treated as ordinary mini-program minimums.
Diagnostic and gated payment APIs do not determine the product floor.
Readiness index keeps R03 pending and links this evidence.
